name: grep-deterministic-no-heading
description: lbabus grep injects --color=never --no-heading, so with an explicit filename (-H) the match prints inline as 'path:line:text' with no ANSI escapes and no grouped heading block — identical whether stdout is a TTY or a pipe. The basename tail 'sample.txt:1:...' is asserted so the check is stable across the Windows/Linux path separator.
